item.title: U.S. gains upper hand in battle for Hormuz
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz has been Iran's key leverage since the war began, but U.S. officials report a shift in control over the past two months.

item.title: Judge again rejects Trump's attempt to dismiss hush money conviction
item.description: A federal judge on Friday declined to overturn President Trump's hush money conviction, saying his arguments were not new or convincing.

item.title: Suspected Chinese bot farm targets US opinion on AI data centers
item.description: X reported that about 200 accounts from a suspected Chinese bot farm have been quietly trying to influence Americans to oppose AI data centers.

item.title: Why the dollar may keep its global dominance in digital era
item.description: New financial technologies are making cross-border money movement faster and cheaper, but the dollar's role may remain strong.
